name: mirage
text: It may well be Novig and not the app. These are thin markets, and 'nobody was selling' means the offer we saw was gone by the time the order arrived. Someone had cancelled it or another taker had filled it. Over 60.5 filling on a later try fits an offer that comes and goes. The sign that it's the app is how old the price was when the order went out, and whether it was the price the list showed. The NOFILL lines give both, so I'll check them in your next saved report (about 20 minutes). If the prices were fresh and still missed, it's Novig's book. If they were stale, it's ours, and I'll fix it.
